name: singlet_annotation_annotation_confidence_calibration
title: Calibrate annotation confidence and abstention
description: Recalibrates an annotator's per-cell class probabilities on held-out donor or study groups and reports calibration error, Brier score, realised coverage and selective accuracy. Writes a calibrated confidence and an abstention flag, and optionally conformal label sets with a stated miscoverage level. Use it after reference label transfer or any probabilistic annotator when trusted labels exist on held-out groups; do not use it to assign labels, to detect cell types absent from the reference, or on in-distribution cells alone.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

annotator.description: Annotator whose probabilities are calibrated; reads obsm/<annotator>_probs and optional uns/<annotator>_logits.

truth_key.description: obs column with trusted labels at the stated level; unlabelled cells are excluded and counted.

split.description: How cells are held out: whole groups only, so no group appears in both calibration and evaluation.

group_key.description: obs column defining held-out groups, usually donor or study.

cal_fraction.description: Fraction of groups used for calibration; the remaining groups are used for evaluation.

method.description: Recalibration family; raw reports diagnostics on uncalibrated scores without writing a calibrated column.

abstain_coverage.description: Target realised coverage used to fit the abstention threshold on calibration groups; the threshold is then frozen.

conformal.description: Conformal label sets with finite-sample coverage under exchangeability; written only when enabled.

enabled.description: Write conformal label sets to obsm/<annotator>_conformal_sets.

alpha.description: Miscoverage level; coverage is at least 1 minus alpha under exchangeability of calibration and test cells.

class_conditional.description: Use per-type (Mondrian) thresholds so coverage holds within each type, when enough calibration cells exist.

min_class_cells.description: Minimum calibration cells for a type's own threshold; below it the marginal threshold is used and the type is flagged.

diagnostics.description: Binning for the calibration error and the reliability curve.

n_bins.description: Equal-width confidence bins for expected calibration error and the reliability curve.

min_bin_count.description: Bins with fewer cells are reported and flagged, and stay in the error sum.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the group split and any stochastic fit; repeated calls with the same seed are identical.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting or writing anything.

overwrite.description: Replace calibration members (obs, obsm, uns, models) written by an earlier call instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/celltypist_best_conf_calibrated. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: method, temperature, ece_raw, ece_calibrated, brier_raw, brier_calibrated, accuracy, abstain_threshold, coverage_realised, n_calibration, flagged_types. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
